settings.text: We want you to love your purchase. If you are not completely satisfied, you can return eligible items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange.

• Item must be unused and in original packaging.
  • Proof of purchase is required.
  • Sale items are final sale unless defective.

1. Contact our support team to start a return.
  2. Pack the item securely with the original packing slip.
  3. Ship using the provided return label.
  4. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

settings.intro: Easy returns and exchanges within 30 days.
